title: Kissed British Mousse Rice Bowl
description: A light and airy mousse on a bed of fluffy rice, kissed with the flavors of Britain.
instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine-mesh strainer and drain well.
In a medium saucepan, combine the rice and 2 cups of water.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
Fluff the rice with a fork and set aside.
In a separate saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Remove from heat and stir in the mousse until well combined.
To assemble the bowl, place a scoop of the cooked rice on a plate, top with a dollop of the mousse mixture, and drizzle with English Rose Petal Jam if desired.
Cook time for the mousse is approximately 5-7 minutes in the microwave or 10-12 minutes in a double boiler.
Note: If using a double boiler, be sure to follow the manufacturer's instructions for temperature and timing.
